explication: D3 is a JavaScript visualization library whose package entry point presents a unified API by re-exporting specialized D3 packages. The principal workflow is a JavaScript consumer importing that entry point and using its data, geometry, rendering, interaction, or timing APIs to build visualizations. The repository evidence sampled here covers the aggregation layer, not the implementations of those packages; capability nodes therefore represent dependency families rather than inspected internals.
